target.role: fresh whole-journey belonging and placement discovery for STRANGE GAIT
target.position: Whole journey: before the opener, between every non-protected pair, or after the tail. Preserve only Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer; Truth in Noise → Transparency remains available.
target.purpose: Test one current constantly shifting techno construction, one emerging gqom/minimal-techno hybrid, one current half-time dub-techno adjacency, and two overlooked broken or arrhythmic catalogue cuts. Character change is allowed; admission still requires purposeful transition, local-run and long-form effect.

sourceWindows: CURRENT 2026 / PEAK OIL: https://leoproducer.bandcamp.com/album/cicada-burnt — all six leo tracks were screened. Spirit Level was retained from the label's exact whirring, constantly shifting rhythm that bends in on itself; Bandcamp Daily independently describes its slow tension build into thudding kicks and watery polyrhythms.

CURRENT / EMERGING HAKUNA KULALA: https://hakunakulala.bandcamp.com/album/skeffu — all eleven Akiid tracks were screened. The title track was retained from the exact rubbery mesh of amapiano, jazz, gqom and minimal techno; no energy or compatibility claim is inferred from that description.

CURRENT / EMERGING PRESSURE DOME: https://pressuredome.bandcamp.com/album/metal-will-reign — all eight How Du tracks were screened. C Gate was retained from the label's exact grouping of alien design, vocal fragments, cavernous bass and spacious half-time rhythm.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / KOMPAKT: https://thefield.bandcamp.com/album/infinite-moment — all six The Field tracks were screened. Who Goes There was retained from the label's exact arrhythmic, stealth-acid and off-kilter motorik description.
OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / FEVER AM: https://ra.co/reviews/29744 — Rhyw's 2018 Emulsion Steps was retained from Resident Advisor's exact bass-heavy broken-techno description.

ADDITIONAL WINDOWS: Major Records' September 2026 brenner release, OBSCUUR's ACE-HIGH, Darknet's Kanzle EP, Squarepusher's 2026 Kammerkonzert, Pressure Dome adjacent catalogue and current Bandcamp electronic listings were screened. None supplied stronger track-specific structural evidence than the five ranked leads.
explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 47 named tracks across current releases, adjacent/emerging artists and labels, and overlooked catalogue windows; metadata and attributed descriptions only, with zero audio auditions.
exclusions: All 14 canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects and every untriggered PARKED revisit were excluded. Exact identities and primary discovery lanes retained in Runs 53–67 were not recycled.
The protected internal handoffs Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer remain unavailable; Truth in Noise → Transparency and every other boundary remain available.
Remixes and alternate versions were excluded from the exact leads. No lead was promoted for recency, geography, artist or label reputation, genre, novelty, title or technical cleverness.

Energy, density, space, hypnosis, perceived pulse, phrase structure, harmonic relation and mixability remain unknown. Descriptive terms such as half-time, arrhythmic and broken are not converted into compatibility claims.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. leo — Spirit Level: strongest current exact structural case, with a constantly shifting rhythm documented to bend in on itself.
2. Akiid — Skeffu: strongest emerging different-world case, an exact rubbery mesh of amapiano, jazz, gqom and minimal techno.
3. The Field — Who Goes There: strongest overlooked arrhythmic case, joining stealth acid to an off-kilter motorik.
4. How Du — C Gate: current half-time dub-techno adjacency with exact track-group evidence but less individual detail.
5. Rhyw — Emulsion Steps: concise overlooked broken-techno lead with exact review evidence.
